request.query: Real power comparison via log x < exponent times log base

items.name: Real.rpow_le_of_le_log
items.type: ∀ {x y z : ℝ}, 0 < y → Real.log x ≤ z * Real.log y → x ≤ y ^ z

items.name: Real.rpow_lt_of_lt_log
items.type: ∀ {x y z : ℝ}, 0 < y → Real.log x < z * Real.log y → x < y ^ z

items.name: Real.pow_lt_of_lt_log
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < y → Real.log x < ↑n * Real.log y → x < y ^ n

items.name: Real.lt_pow_of_log_lt
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < y → Real.log x < ↑n * Real.log y → x < y ^ n

items.name: Real.le_pow_iff_log_le
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ} {n : ℕ}, 0 < x → 0 < y → (x ≤ y ^ n ↔ Real.log x ≤ ↑n * Real.log y)
